# War Scroll Column 13 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 13 | **Condition:** complete

---

**13:1** The battle belongs to You alone, and by the strength of Your hand their bodies lie scattered with no one to bury them. You handed Goliath

**13:2** of Gath, that great champion, over to Your servant David, because David put his trust in the name of

**13:3** Your supreme holiness, not in sword or spear. The battle has always been Yours. David defeated

**13:4** the Philistines time and again by the power of Your holy name. Through our kings as well, You rescued us

**13:5** again and again because of Your faithful love, not because of anything we deserved, for we acted wickedly, and not for our rebellious sins.

**13:6** The battle is Yours, and the power comes from You alone, not from us. It is not our strength or the power

**13:7** of our own hands that has won the victory, but only Your strength and the power of Your great courage. Long ago You told us

**13:8** this promise: A star will come out of Jacob, and a ruler will rise from Israel. He will shatter the skull

**13:9** of Moab and bring down all the descendants of Seth. He will rule from Jacob and destroy every last survivor of the enemy city.

**13:10** The enemy will be conquered, and Israel will triumph. Today is the day God has appointed to crush and humiliate the chief

**13:11** of the kingdom of evil. He will send help that lasts forever to the people He has redeemed, through the power of His glorious

**13:12** angel. The reign of Michael will shine in eternal light, bringing joy to Israel's covenant, peace and blessing

**13:13** for God's own people, lifting the authority of Michael above all the angels and the sovereignty of Israel

**13:14** above every nation on earth. Justice will sing for joy in the heavens, and all who hold to God's truth will celebrate

**13:15** in knowledge that lasts forever. Stand strong, you who belong to His covenant! You are in God's refining fire, and He will finish His work

**13:16** when He raises His hand and completes His mysterious purposes. Then you will stand firm on the day

**13:17** when He comes.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 13 builds confidence for the final battle by recalling God's past victories, especially David over Goliath. The Star Prophecy (Numbers 24:17) in 13:8-9 was one of the most important messianic texts at Qumran. "Prince of the dominion of wickedness" rendered as "chief of the kingdom of evil" for clarity. Michael's exaltation (13:12-14) is the cosmic climax. The "crucible" metaphor (13:15-16) rendered as "refining fire" for modern readers.*
